collection.title: Chevrolet Camaro 1993 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chevrolet Camaro 1993 - 2002 requires a 24" wiper blade the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style blade.
